description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of items across three hierarchical levels, labeled “Level 1 - 8.2”, “Level 2 - 12.1”, and “Level 3 - 7.0”, with each segment corresponding to a distinct category. The chart is divided into three slices, each with a unique color and percentage value displayed within it. The largest segment, colored a medium blue, represents “Level 2 - 12.1” and accounts for 44.32% of the total. The second largest segment, in a lighter blue, corresponds to “Level 1 - 8.2” and makes up 30.4% of the total. The smallest segment, in a darker blue, represents “Level 3 - 7.0” and constitutes 25.64% of the total. The percentages are explicitly labeled inside each slice, and the chart does not include a separate legend or exploded segments; the categories are identified by their position and associated text outside the pie. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the bottom left and proceeding clockwise.
